beginner.summary: For people who have used a spreadsheet or another programming language and are new to MATLAB. Covers the desktop and Live Editor, numeric types and floating-point precision, vectors and matrices, indexing and logical masks, linear algebra with backslash, control flow and preallocation, functions and the search path, strings, cells, structs, dictionaries, tables and datetimes, file import and export, data cleaning, plotting and exporting figures, descriptive statistics, curve fitting, debugging, live scripts with Git, and a sensor-log capstone.
prerequisites: Comfortable with high-school algebra, vectors and basic statistics
Has used a spreadsheet or written a few lines of code in any language
Has MATLAB installed with a licence, or a MathWorks account for MATLAB Online
outcomes: Navigate the desktop and write scripts, functions and live scripts that run without errors
Create, index and combine vectors, matrices, tables and text correctly, and solve linear systems with backslash
Import, clean, summarize and plot real data and export publication-quality figures
Debug code with breakpoints and the Code Analyzer and keep work under Git version control

intermediate.summary: For analysts and engineers who write MATLAB scripts and now need maintainable, fast and tested code. Covers function validation with arguments blocks, error handling, vectorization, memory and the Profiler, classes and handles, closures, timetables, datastore and tall arrays, sparse matrices and factorizations, solvers and optimization, integration and differentiation, ODEs, Fourier analysis, filter design, image segmentation, machine learning with Statistics and Machine Learning Toolbox, parallel computing, unit testing, App Designer, and a vibration-analysis capstone.

Apply numerical solvers, spectral analysis, filter design, image segmentation and classification to real data

advanced.summary: For experienced MATLAB users who build and ship engineering software. Covers projects and toolbox packaging, buildtool and CI, headless and container runs, MEX and C++ libraries, Python interoperability, MATLAB Coder, GPU computing, clusters and Parallel Server, deep learning with dlnetwork and trainnet, Bayesian optimization and explainability, Kalman filtering, constrained optimization, PDEs and finite elements, Simulink modelling, scripted simulation, Stateflow, verification and coverage, deployment with MATLAB Compiler and Production Server, REST services, and a predictive-maintenance capstone.
prerequisites: Completed the intermediate material or writes tested MATLAB functions, classes and apps
Comfortable with Git, a command line and basic C or Python
Has access to MATLAB, Simulink and the Coder, Compiler, Parallel Computing and Statistics and Machine Learning products, or equivalent trial licences
outcomes: Package, build, test and release MATLAB code through projects, buildtool and CI
Accelerate and deploy algorithms with MEX, MATLAB Coder, GPUs, clusters and MATLAB Production Server
Model, simulate and verify dynamic systems with Simulink, Stateflow and scripted parameter sweeps
Deliver an end-to-end machine learning service with measurable accuracy, generated-code fidelity and latency
